---
name: Bug report
about: A skill didn't load, or an agent did the wrong thing with it
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Which skill

The folder name under `skills/` — e.g. `study-set-builder`.

## What you asked for

The exact phrasing you typed. This is what separates a discovery problem (the skill never loaded)
from a behaviour problem (it loaded and did the wrong thing).

## What happened

What the agent did, including any output from a bundled script.

## What you expected instead

A clear description of the correct behaviour.

## Environment

- Agent and editor (e.g. Copilot in VS Code):
- Commit or date of the skills you were using:

## Additional context

Logs, screenshots, or the relevant part of the transcript.
